Sandbox_StoryEngine_Monologue_tooltip: The character mutters short thoughts when feelings change or something happens (first kill, bites, new towns...).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_MonologueAI_tooltip: Write the thoughts with the AI bridge. When off, only built-in lines are used (no API cost).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_MonologueGap_tooltip: Least time between two thoughts of the same character. Bites, low health and first kill ignore this.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_RequireRadio_tooltip: When on, talking to radio contacts, handing over items and paying for trades need a walkie-talkie or ham radio (carried, or placed within 2 tiles).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ModItemsRatio_toolti: Chance that food, melee weapons and guns in rewards and trades are swapped for similar items from all installed items (including other mods). 0 = vanilla lists only.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Director_tooltip: Twice a day (08:00, 20:00) the AI picks an event: supplies, storms, requests from radio contacts, hordes, helicopters, distress calls.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_NpcRequests_tooltip: Radio contacts ask for items or for help clearing a horde, about once or twice a week.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_DangerEvents_tooltip: Allow the director to send a small horde toward a survivor, or a helicopter over the area.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Journal_tooltip: The AI writes a diary entry every midnight and a memoir when a character dies. Players can read each other's journals.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ALifeSupport_tooltip: When Project A-Life is running: a highly trusted contact (70+ by default) sends an armed squad on their own when you are in serious danger or under attack: A-Life raids and robberies, or this mod's chasing hordes and armed gangs (once every 7 days by default, see the 'NPC Life, Specialties' page). The Guard's specialty also becomes an A-Life squad. Ignoring a threat brings that group's armed men instead of a horde.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Banter_tooltip: When characters are within 10 tiles of each other, the AI writes a short exchange every 3 in-game hours, and right away when something happens (fighting together, a bite, a horde closing in, quests, radio news, a death). Shown above their heads and kept in the journal. With a companion nearby, this replaces the solo monologue.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Social: NPC social life (calls, stories, open channel, crises)
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Social_tooltip: Contacts call you 4-6 times a day even without business, each has a personal story that branches on linked quests, they talk among themselves on an open channel, and sometimes several of them ask for help at once so you have to choose.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Specialty_tooltip: From the bases tab, ask a contact you trust (40+) for their specialty: squad backup, treatment, vehicle repair, scouting, supply runs, comfort, sniper cover or decoy noise. Each has its own cooldown.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_NpcFate_tooltip: A contact dies or leaves if their story reaches its end without a single request fulfilled, or if all their supplies (food, medicine, weapons, comforts) stay near zero for 3 days. Never from combat or chance. When off, the worst ending becomes badly hurt but alive, and running out only brings warnings.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Broadcast_tooltip: Every day at 19:00 Casey (or Ray) reads the day's events and tomorrow's weather on in-game radio 105.4 MHz (or the nearest free frequency), with a rerun at 07:00. Listening with a radio tuned in goes into your journal. Needs the AI connection.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_WorldChanges_tooltip: When the power or water goes out, winter or the first snow arrives, or day 30/90/180 comes, contacts react on the radio and their supplies (power: Casey's comforts and June's medicine, water: everyone's food, winter: a little more food every day) and requests (batteries, water, heating) change. It also goes into everyone's journal.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Letters_tooltip: Gift drops from close contacts (trust 70+) and Ray's greenhouse drops sometimes include a handwritten letter, and contacts who finish a project or leave the county send one with the next drop. Right-click "Read letter"; reading it goes into your journal.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Difficulty_tooltip:
Sets the core numbers (trust, rewards, prices, horde size, how well contacts hold up) in one go.
- Custom: use the individual values on these pages (defaults = Normal).
- Relaxed: trust grows faster and drops less, bigger rewards, cheaper trades, smaller hordes, sturdier contacts.
- Normal: the original balance.
- Harsh: trust grows slowly and drops hard, smaller rewards, pricier trades, bigger hordes, fragile contacts.

Options the preset controls end with a [Difficulty] note. Everything else always uses its own value.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_TrustStart_tooltip:
Added to each radio contact's starting trust (base: Ray and Casey 30, June 25, Pike 20, Dewey 15, Whitaker 10, Vic 5, Hank 0).
Trading opens at 20, better deals and specialties at 40/60/80.
Applies to new games and contacts not reached yet. Trust in an ongoing save does not change.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 15 / Normal 0 / Harsh -10.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_TrustGainMult_toolti:
Every trust increase is multiplied by this (finished quests, trades, donations, taking a side in a crisis, talk...).
1 = unchanged, 2 = friends twice as fast, 0 = trust never goes up. When not 0, a gain is at least 1.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 1.5 / Normal 1 / Harsh 0.75.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_TrustLossMult_toolti:
Every trust decrease is multiplied by this (failures, refusals, no answer, snubs, asking too often, rude talk...).
1 = unchanged, 0.5 = half the loss, 0 = trust never drops. Applied after the early/late game penalty scaling.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 0.5 / Normal 1 / Harsh 1.5.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_SuspiciousRequests_t:
From this many item requests to the same contact within 7 in-game days (whole server), every further request costs 1 trust and makes them suspicious.
Raise it to ask more often without penalty.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Spillover_tooltip:
When on, big favors to one contact (tier 3+ requests or trades, crisis choices, large donations) also move trust by 1 with contacts who like or dislike them (only 3 in 10 of Vic's dealings get around).
When off, each contact's trust only changes through your dealings with them.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_RequestGapDays_toolt:
In-game days after a contact asks for something (items, horde clearing, fetch, distress call, extortion) before they may ask again.
After that it rolls 50 percent a day, then 60, and so on. Lower = more frequent requests.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_RequestServerGapDays:
Across all contacts, only one request is made per this many days (so quests don't pile up). 0 = no limit.
Emergency requests (a contact running out of something) ignore this.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_QuestTimeMult_toolti:
Multiplies quest deadlines (48 h + 10 h per 100 tiles for supply, fetch and horde quests; 48 + 24×tier h for delivering requested items).
2 = twice the time, 0.5 = half. Answer windows (6 h requests, 12 h trades) and extortion deadlines stay the same.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 1.5 / Normal 1 / Harsh 0.75.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_RewardMult_tooltip:
Multiplies the count of food, water, medicine and each contact's specialty bundle (Ray's cans, June's medicine...) in reward drops. Fractions round by chance.
Guns, tools and melee weapons keep their counts (the tier sets their quality).

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 1.3 / Normal 1 / Harsh 0.75.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_StageMidDay_tooltip: From this server day the game enters mid game: quest/event max tier 2 → 4, trust penalties go from half to full, chasing hordes and raids grow.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_StageLateDay_tooltip: From this server day: max tier 5, failing high-tier quests costs much more trust, hordes and raids are largest. If not after mid game, it becomes the day after.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_PriceMult_tooltip:
Multiplies what contacts ask in return for radio trades, on top of the trust bracket (x2 to x1), faction habits (Pike x0.8, Vic's markup) and their supply situation.
The haggling floor moves with it.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 0.75 / Normal 1 / Harsh 1.3.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_GiftChance_tooltip:
Each time you ask a contact with trust 60+ for something, the chance that this time they give it for free (tier 2 or lower, never while suspicious).
0 = they always want something in return.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ZombieMult_tooltip:
Multiplies every zombie group this mod creates.
- Clear-out quests: 12 / 20 / 30 / 45 / 65 by tier
- Inside rescue-signal supply buildings: (tier + 1) x 2
- Chasing hordes (director horde, extortion revenge, staying too long): early 20 / mid 40 / late 60, also multiplied by the chasing horde size below
- Clear-out sites and incoming waves of repair operations and big events

One group is capped at 300 zombies. Always used, whatever the difficulty preset.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_HuntSizeMult_tooltip:
Multiplies the zombie count of chasing hordes (early 20 / mid 40 / late 60) sent by the director, extortion revenge, or staying in one place too long. The mod zombie count multiplier above applies on top.
Chasing hordes follow their target until destroyed.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 0.6 / Normal 1 / Harsh 1.5.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Extortion_tooltip:
Threatening factions (Vic's gang, the Guard) with trust 10 or less demand goods every 5 days. Ignoring them brings revenge (chasing horde, helicopter, or armed men with A-Life).
Never happens while 'Director: hordes and helicopters' is off.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_StayHorde_tooltip:
Staying within 150 tiles of one spot for several days rolls once a day (30 percent at first, 10 more each day) for a chasing horde. Turn off to make a long stay at base safe.
Never happens while 'Director: hordes and helicopters' is off.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_StayHordeDays_toolti: How many days in one place before 'Horde when staying too long' starts rolling.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_HeliGapDays_tooltip: Least in-game days between director helicopter events (whole server). The helicopter draws zombies around.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_RaidSizeMult_tooltip:
With Project A-Life, multiplies the armed group sent after ignored extortion (early 3 / mid 5 / late 7). At most 8.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 0.7 / Normal 1 / Harsh 1.4.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_LifeDrift_tooltip:
How much a contact's food, medicine, weapons and comforts move toward their normal level each day. Anything below 20 cannot recover on its own (they need your help).
0 = only events and your help change them.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 8 / Normal 5 / Harsh 3.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_LifeLossMult_tooltip:
Multiplies contact supply losses from failed or refused requests, snubs in a crisis, storms, clashes, story events, winter and so on.
The cost of asking for a specialty and sharing between contacts are unchanged.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 0.6 / Normal 1 / Harsh 1.4.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_StarveDays: Days before a starving contact leaves
Sandbox_StoryEngine_StarveDays_tooltip:
After this many days with all four supplies below 10, a contact abandons their place (with warning calls before that).
Only warnings if 'Contacts can die or leave' is off or its cause excludes running out.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 5 / Normal 3 / Harsh 2.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_NpcFateCause_tooltip:
Which causes apply while 'Contacts can die or leave' is on.
- Story and running out: default.
- Story only: only when their personal story ends without a single request fulfilled. Running out only brings warnings.
- Running out only: only when supplies stay empty. The worst story ending becomes badly hurt but alive.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ProjectGoal_tooltip:
Points needed to finish a contact's long-term project (Ray's greenhouse, Casey's antenna, June's clinic...). Donations (1 value = 1 point), story requests +100, crisis side +50, tier 3+ requests +25.
Changing it rescales progress of projects already underway.

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 700 / Normal 1000 / Harsh 1500.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ProjectDonateCap_too: Most points one [Support project] donation can add. Items beyond that are not taken.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_DonateGapDays_toolti: In-game days before the same contact accepts another donation or project support (whole server). 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_SpecialtyCooldownMul:
Multiplies specialty cooldowns (Guard, June, Dewey, Ray 7 days; Casey, Pike, Hank 3; Vic 1). 0 = no cooldown (the supply cost still applies).

[Difficulty] Used only when Difficulty is 'Custom'. Relaxed 0.6 / Normal 1 / Harsh 1.5.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_SpecialtyTrustOffset: Added to the trust needed for specialty levels (40 / 60 / 80). -20 gives 20 / 40 / 60, +10 gives 50 / 70 / 90.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_AutoSupportTrust_too: With Project A-Life, when a player is in serious danger (surrounded and badly hurt, raided, robbed, chased by a horde or armed men), the closest faction with at least this much trust sends a squad on its own.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_AutoSupportDays_tool: In-game days before the same player can get automatic backup again.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_AISaver_tooltip:
When on, doubles the gaps for contacts calling first, open channel scenes, banter between characters and monologue (multiplies the values below and 'Monologue: minimum gap').
Cuts API calls and cost roughly in half. Director, journal and radio replies are unchanged.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ContactHours_tooltip:
Average gap between contacts calling you on their own (in-game hours, ±1 h). 5 means 4-6 calls a day. The same contact waits at least 8 hours.
Needs 'NPC social life'.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_SceneHours_tooltip: Average gap between scenes where 2-3 contacts talk to each other on the open channel (121.5), ±1 h. When a player speaks there, they answer right away regardless.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_BanterHours_tooltip:
In multiplayer, how often nearby characters chat when nothing is happening (in-game hours). Events like fighting together or a bite still trigger right away.
Needs 'Characters talk to each other'.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_LetterChance_tooltip: Chance that a gift drop from a close contact (trust 70+) or Ray's greenhouse drop includes a handwritten letter. Letters for finished projects or farewells always come.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_BroadcastHour_toolti: In-game hour when the radio evening news (105.4 MHz) airs (13-23).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_BroadcastRerun_toolt: When on, the previous evening's news airs again between 07:00 and 11:59 the next day. Hearing it twice still goes into the journal once.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Operations_tooltip:
Starting two weeks after the vanilla power or water shutoff, a daily roll (10 percent at first, 5 more each day) starts a 5-step repair operation across several towns (about 12-14 days).
Recover papers, gather supplies, clear the dead around facilities, hold a facility, then a final visit. Sites are the real water towers, pylons and substations on the vanilla map.
During an operation the contacts help without their specialty cooldowns. Success brings power or water back for 60 days. After a failure, or when it fails again after 60 days, the roll starts again two weeks later.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Sagas_tooltip:
From server day 25, one event every 14-21 days that grows over several days.
- Helicopter crash: choose whether the Guard, Vic or June gets the cargo, then face the dead and looters drawn to it.
- Great migration: a huge horde crosses the county past Ray's farm and the church. Gather barricade supplies.
- Fever epidemic: contacts fall sick one by one and nurse June collapses. How much medicine is gathered decides who recovers or dies.
- Radio blackout: the relay mast fails and only Casey can be heard. Clear the mast and gather parts.
The same event does not repeat within 60 days and never runs alongside a repair operation. Requests, threats and crises pause during an event.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Named_tooltip: From day 10, now and then (6 days apart server-wide) a contact asks you to put someone they knew to rest: a zombie in that person's clothes carries a keepsake. Hand it over by radio for a reward and trust.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Recover_tooltip: When a character dies and the same account starts a new one, a contact who knew the old one points out where they fell. A notebook with their last diary pages lies there (deaths within 30 days).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Holidays_tooltip: Korean holidays when the game language is Korean, otherwise American ones. Two days' notice with an ingredient drive, a feast and gifts on the day, and a small gift for the first call on New Year's or Christmas morning (Seollal and New Year's Day in Korean).
